events.title: The Rinha de Waifus demo is available!
events.summary: Steam has just approved Rinha de Waifus demo!Leading up to the launch, we’ll be treating the demo as an open playtest. It will feature all the latest game updates and new content. Your feedback is highly welcome, as it will help me shape the future of Rinha de Waifus.I truly hope you have as much fun with RDW as I do!
